description: Java source code for an Android Fragment named StorageClientFragment, which facilitates file selection (images) from device storage, handles activity results, and displays selected images with metadata logging.

classes.name: StorageClientFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that manages file selection through system file chooser, handles the results, and displays selected images.

classes.name: ImageDialogFragment
classes.description: A nested DialogFragment class that displays an image given its URI, loading it asynchronously and showing metadata.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initial setup, indicates this fragment has options menu.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selection, triggers file search.

methods.name: performFileSearch
methods.description: Creates an intent to open the document picker filtered for images.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Processes the result from the file picker, retrieves URI, and triggers image display.

methods.name: showImage
methods.description: Creates and shows a dialog to display the selected image from URI.
